🌟 build123d | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Creating precise, parametric 2D and 3D CAD models programmatically using Python for manufacturing applications.
✨ Key Features: • Parametric 2D and 3D CAD modeling • Pythonic interface • Built on Open Cascade geometric kernel • Suitable for 3D printing, CNC machining, laser cutting • Operator-driven modeling for algebraic design
📖 Summary: Build123d is a Python framework for parametric 2D and 3D CAD modeling, built on the Open Cascade geometric kernel. It offers a Pythonic interface for creating precise models suitable for manufacturing processes like 3D printing and CNC machining.
